name: Jonah Whitlock
role: Independent operations consultant for mid-size manufacturers (fictional)
bio: Fictional eval persona. Went independent in 2025 after twelve years in plant operations. Works with packaging and plastics manufacturers on changeovers and flow.
opinions: The people on the line already know where the time goes
writing_samples: We filmed three changeovers. Nobody liked watching them back. Everybody agreed on what to fix.
Most of the time on a changeover is not spent changing anything.
